data.body: Converted to epic. Diagnosis requires CI reproduction (60x perf degradation, CI-only). Existing test code already has the standard protections (_TICKET_TEST_NO_SYNC=1, sandboxed dso shims, per-test fixture isolation). The bug needs empirical investigation — CI instrumentation, runner-load profiling, or rare-failure capture — not a code fix from code review alone. The suspect refactor commit 6426d4dfd6 has had limited follow-on changes; no obvious hot loop or unstubbed call.
